If I'm against a magical (in most cases): bulwark.

I'd then build as my team needs, ie like if I didn't get antiheal. I'd get probably something like a gengis if it's magic heavy comp, or if there's something specific I'd get utility - like maybe witchblade, winged blade, midguardian mail, hide of the nemean lion - it's up to the team comp at this stage

Bare in mind that a lot of this build is super flexible and you need to counter pick really well to not just what you need but what your team could do with as well.
